added_lines: love god and your neighbour matthew 22:34–40 jesus brings us to the heart of faith: love god with our whole being and love our neighbour as ourselves. these commandments belong together. our prayer should shape how we treat others, especially those who inconvenience us, misunderstand us or cannot repay our kindness. to love god wholeheartedly is to bring him our fears, disappointments and weaknesses, trusting that we are loved even in our poverty. loving our neighbour means seeking their good through patience, forgiveness and honesty. and “as yourself” reminds us that we too are people god loves. humility acknowledges our faults while allowing us to receive his mercy. this gospel invites us to ask: are our prayers, plans and activities helping us become more loving? lord, let me receive your love today, and let that love shape how i treat the next person i meet. holy family parish draw our parish draw will begin in january 2027 to provide funds for the refurbishment and
